comment.body: Thanks for identifying the French AZERTY layout and exact AltGr+- sequence that should type `|`. To distinguish a PowerToys shortcut collision from another remapper, could you share the Text Extractor activation shortcut shown in Settings and confirm whether AltGr+- still opens it with other keyboard-remapping tools temporarily disabled? Please name the active French layout and physical keys used. The expected character and unintended action are already clear, so a general log request would not resolve this mapping question.
